result.reason: The addition appropriately provides up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data return, deletion, and written certification without altering unrelated commercial terms. However, the data-return deadline runs from Corio’s request rather than from expiration or termination, so it does not ensure export within 30 days of termination as required by the playbook. It also conflicts with Section 11.3’s immediate option to destroy Confidential Information, which could permit Commerce One to destroy covered data before Corio requests its return. The clause should require return within 30 days after termination (or an election made at termination) and clarify that Section 11.4 controls over the destruction option in Section 11.3.
